panels.visual: The mound of Hisarlik in a field in Turkey, with layers of ruins cut in a trench, Glauka flying over
panels.caption: Troy was a real city, at a place we now call Hisarlik, in Turkey.

panels.visual: Schliemann in the trench holding up a cross-section drawing with nine layered cities, one burning red
panels.caption: Schliemann found nine cities, each built on top of the one before. One layer burned around 1180 BC.

panels.visual: A great siege: ten years of tents around a wall, a question mark over a queen's silhouette (Helen)
panels.caption: Did a Greek army really besiege it for ten years over a queen called Helen? Nobody knows.

panels.visual: Gold jewellery and cups piled in a basket labelled PRIAM'S TREASURE, Schliemann smuggling a box out under a coat; a Russian museum shown in a thought bubble
panels.caption: Schliemann smuggled the gold out of Turkey. It is now in a museum in Moscow.
